name: JR

notes.name: Wikipedia · JR (artist)
notes.q: In January 2014, JR collaborated with the New York City Ballet for their second annual Art Series program, by exhibiting work in the theatre in Lincoln Center, including an interactive piece on the floor of the promenade.

src.name: Wikipedia · JR (artist)
src.q: In 2013, he continued working in New York City, with the Inside Out Project in Times Square, which challenged advertising with a massive work of art consisting of thousands of portraits of locals and tourists.

notes.name: Wikipedia · JR (artist)
notes.q: Time magazine included JR in its list of the 100 most influential people in 2018.

notes.name: Wikipedia · JR (artist)
notes.q: In 2018, JR partnered with Time magazine, to produce their cover story, featuring over two hundred Americans who have been impacted by guns, including "hunters and activists, teachers and police officers, parents and children", to produce "Guns in America"—a talking mural—on one of the most polarizing issues in the United States today.

src.name: Wikipedia · JR (artist)
src.q: That year, he also worked on his Giants series in Rio de Janeiro during the 2016 Olympics, creating new gigantic sculptural installations at the scale of the city, depicting competing athletes in action, supported by scaffolding.

works: La Ferita, 25 Mars 2021, 19H07, Palazzo Strozzi, Florence, Italie, 2021
